name: Card
purpose: Generic content container with an optional footer pinned to its bottom edge.

parts.name: container
parts.description: Card fill, 1px border, extra-large radius, column layout.

parts.name: body
parts.description: Grows to fill available height; 16px padding with 12px vertical spacing between children.

parts.name: footer
parts.description: Separated by a 1px top border; 16px horizontal and 8px vertical padding; always at the bottom even when body content is short.

layout: In grids, equal-height cards keep footers aligned because the body stretches.
responsive: Fills the width its parent grants.
accessibility: Plain container; consumer supplies headings and landmarks.

name: GridList
purpose: Selectable, keyboard-navigable collection of items shown as a grid of cards.

parts.name: list
parts.description: Grid with 16px gaps: one column on narrow screens, three columns from 768px.

parts.name: item
parts.description: 16px padding, card fill, 1px border, large radius, pointer cursor.

variants.name: item hover color
variants.description: Border color on hover and ring color on keyboard focus (2px ring, 1px offset).

responsive: 1 column below 768px; 3 columns at 768px and above.
accessibility: Grid list semantics; arrow keys move focus; Enter activates; selection announced.

name: TagGroup
purpose: A set of compact labels, optionally selectable or removable.

parts.name: group label
parts.description: Visually hidden, available to assistive technology only.

parts.name: list
parts.description: Wrapping row with 8px gaps.

parts.name: tag
parts.description: Pill: 12px horizontal and 4px vertical padding, 14px text, 1px border. When removable, shows a 12px X glyph 4px after the text.

variants.name: color
variants.description: Accent tags use the light accent fill, accent text and a 20% accent border; default uses secondary fill, foreground text and the standard border.

constraints: Default color is neutral, not an accent.
accessibility: Tag group role with per-tag focus; Backspace or Delete removes when removable.

name: PageHeader
purpose: Title block for a page with optional breadcrumbs, description and actions.

parts.name: breadcrumbs
parts.description: Navigation landmark above the title; ordered list of 14px muted-foreground items separated by '/'. Items with a link or handler are links that brighten to foreground on hover; the rest are plain foreground text.

parts.name: title
parts.description: Level-one heading, 24px medium-weight foreground, truncated to one line.

parts.name: description
parts.description: 14px muted-foreground paragraph 4px below the title.

parts.name: actions
parts.description: Row of controls with 8px gap aligned to the right, never shrinking.

layout: Column with 4px gap; title block and actions in a row aligned to the top with 16px gap; 24px bottom padding and a 1px bottom border.
responsive: No breakpoint-specific behavior; long titles truncate.
constraints: Exactly one level-one heading per page.

name: FilterSidebar
purpose: Collapsible groups of checkbox filters with counts and a clear-all action.

parts.name: container
parts.description: Side region 224px wide that does not shrink; column with 16px gap.

parts.name: header
parts.description: Row with the word 'Filters' (14px medium foreground) and, when any filter is selected, a 'Clear all (N)' text button (12px, orange, underline on hover).

parts.name: group
parts.description: Separated from the previous by a 1px top border and 16px padding. Heading button shows the group label (14px medium) and an up or down chevron (16px muted-foreground) for expanded or collapsed.

parts.name: option
parts.description: A checkbox (16px square, 2px border, white 10px check) with label (14px foreground, grows) and an optional count (12px muted-foreground) at the right; options are 8px apart.

responsive: Container does not shrink; ListPage hides it below 768px.
constraints: Group expansion is internal state, initially expanded unless the group opts out.
accessibility: Group toggles are buttons; checkboxes are labelled; the container is a complementary region.

name: ViewToggle
purpose: Two-option segmented switch between list and grid presentations.

parts.name: group
parts.description: Joined pair of buttons labelled 'View mode'.

parts.name: list button
parts.description: Icon-only (16px list icon), accessible name 'List view', rounded on the left, no right border.

parts.name: grid button
parts.description: Icon-only (16px grid icon), accessible name 'Grid view', rounded on the right.

variants.name: color
variants.description: Selected button fill and border; icon turns white.

layout: Buttons have 8px padding all around; exactly one is selected.
accessibility: Each button exposes pressed state and has an accessible name.

name: StatCard
purpose: Displays one headline metric with optional trend and icon.

parts.name: container
parts.description: 20px padding, card fill, 1px border, extra-large radius, column with 12px gap.

parts.name: title
parts.description: 14px muted-foreground text at the top left.

parts.name: icon tile
parts.description: Top right: 20px icon in the accent color on a light accent fill, 8px padding, large radius.

parts.name: value
parts.description: 30px medium-weight foreground number with tight line height, bottom left.

parts.name: trend
parts.description: Bottom right: 14px direction icon (up, down, flat) and a 12px medium-weight value.

parts.name: caption
parts.description: 12px muted-foreground line below; shows the trend's label if provided, otherwise the description.

variants.name: color
variants.description: Icon and its tile. Trend colors: down is always accent-red and neutral is muted-foreground; up is accent-green, except orange where up is orange.

layout: Title row, then value/trend row aligned to the bottom, then caption.
responsive: Fills the grid cell it is placed in.
constraints: The caption prefers the trend label over the description.
accessibility: Trend direction should not rely on color alone; the icon and signed value convey it.

name: EmptyState
purpose: Placeholder shown when a view has nothing to display.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: Centered, muted-foreground at 40% opacity.

parts.name: title
parts.description: Level-three heading, 16px medium foreground.

parts.name: description
parts.description: 14px muted-foreground, centered, max width 24rem.

parts.name: action
parts.description: A call-to-action control.

layout: Centered column with 16px gap, 64px vertical and 24px horizontal padding; title and description 4px apart.
constraints: No background or border of its own.
accessibility: Icon is decorative; title provides the meaning.
